items.title: Popular AI models get medication doses wrong, some dangerously: Doximity
items.excerpt: Research released by Doximity shows its dose verification tool outperformed general-use AI models, which it says are rife with medication-dosing errors, some dangerous.

items.title: NYU Langone brings OpenEvidence's clinical AI into the EHR systemwide
items.excerpt: NYU Langone Health is integrating OpenEvidence's clinical AI search into its electronic health record across the system, the latest marquee New York partnership for the evidence platform.

items.title: Counsel Health launches AI-native weight management program, inks partnership with Lilly Direct
items.excerpt: AI-native primary care company Counsel Health is moving into the GLP-1 market with a weight management program that pairs obesity medications with on-demand physicians and an AI care layer, partnering with LillyDirect.

items.title: Changes in Service Use Following the Introduction of AI-Enabled Prior Authorization in Medicare
items.excerpt: Using Epic Cosmos data, this study assesses changes in Medicare beneficiaries' use of medical services after AI-enabled prior authorization requirements began under CMS Innovation Center's WISeR model. (Date: Crossref created; DOI 10.1001/jama.2026.21230)

items.title: Systemwide adoption patterns of ambient AI scribe technology in an integrated academic health system
items.excerpt: A retrospective cohort of 2,901 ambulatory clinicians using linked EHR data shows who adopted ambient AI scribes, and how heavily, during an enterprise-scale rollout.

items.title: Performance of artificial intelligence for fracture detection: an umbrella review and second-order meta-analysis
items.excerpt: An umbrella review and second-order meta-analysis pools systematic reviews of regulator-approved AI fracture detection tools to estimate real diagnostic performance.

items.title: An agentic AI system enhances clinical detection of immune-related adverse events in a multi-phase validation study
items.excerpt: Gallifant et al. develop and validate, across multiple phases, an AI agent that helps clinicians detect and assess immune-related adverse events in patients on cancer immunotherapy.

items.title: Does AI-Powered Clinical Documentation Enhance Clinician Efficiency? A Longitudinal Study
items.excerpt: A longitudinal study tracks whether AI-powered clinical documentation actually improves clinician efficiency over time. (Date: Crossref created; DOI 10.1056/AIx2601335)

items.title: AI-Assisted Molecular Review Refines SMO Inhibitor Candidacy in SHH Medulloblastoma
items.excerpt: A case study in which AI-assisted molecular review refined which SHH medulloblastoma patients were candidates for SMO inhibitor therapy. (Date: Crossref created)

items.title: HOPPR releases whole-body MSK x-ray report drafting model
items.excerpt: HOPPR is launching a beta of its FS MSK Whole-Body Narrative Model, a vision-language foundation model that generates draft findings text for musculoskeletal radiographs using up to three views per study.

items.title: FDA clears Deep Reasoning AI's neurovascular CTA software
items.excerpt: Deep Reasoning AI received FDA 510(k) clearance for NeuroDR, which runs automatically after a CT angiography scan, strips bone, soft tissue and veins, and pushes 3D views of the carotid and vertebral arteries to PACS.

items.title: SIIM-CAIMI: Apollo LLM framework shows promise in patient monitoring
items.excerpt: Faisal Mahmood, PhD, shared updates from his team's work developing the Apollo LLM framework for longitudinal patient monitoring.

items.title: NECA, AI 의료기술 허가·평가·급여제도 정책 논의
items.excerpt: 한국보건의료연구원(NECA)이 AI 의료기술의 시장 진입과 임상현장 활용을 뒷받침할 허가·평가·급여 제도와 임상근거 체계를 논의했다.

items.title: 흉부 엑스레이로 심장 기능 저하 예측 AI 모델 개발
items.excerpt: 용인세브란스병원 심장내과 정인현·배성아 교수와 연세의대 윤덕용 교수 연구팀이 흉부 엑스레이만으로 심장 기능 저하를 예측하는 AI 모델을 개발했다.

items.title: 루닛, '키트루다' 넘은 차세대 항암제에 AI 심는다
items.excerpt: 루닛이 서밋 테라퓨틱스와 이중항체 항암제 '이보네시맙'의 AI 병리 기반 바이오마커 발굴 연구 계약을 맺고 치료 반응 예측에 AI를 적용한다.

items.title: 건보공단, 의료이용 이상징후 탐지 AI로 혁신챌린지 최우수상
items.excerpt: 국민건강보험공단이 건강보험 빅데이터로 의료이용 과정의 이상징후를 조기 탐지하는 AI 모델을 개발해 실증 성과를 인정받았다.

items.title: 원격중환자실 4개 권역으로 확대…서울도 11월 가동
items.excerpt: 보건복지부 원격중환자실(e-ICU) 사업이 11월 서울 권역(삼성서울병원 거점)으로 확대되며, 환자 상태 악화 예측·영상 기반 생체정보 분석·음성인식 협진 요약 등 3종의 AI를 도입한다.

items.title: AI로 체험후기 조작하고 의사 사칭까지…부당광고 420건 적발
items.excerpt: 한국소비자원이 9개월간 유튜브 AI 활용 광고를 모니터링해 AI로 체험후기를 조작하거나 의사를 사칭한 부당광고 420건을 적발했다. 질병 치료 효과를 내세운 광고도 포함됐다.
